classification: pre-registered engine-vintage reconciliation and full A/B/C rebuild before any trade-level audit result is accepted; research-only

trigger.reason: R371 2x curves predate the ext-field matrix attachment fix. Reusing them together with current-engine trades is invalid.

question: After rebuilding A, B (hold-30 centre), B20 control and all C cohorts under the current engine, does the hold-30 centre still pass performance, sealed-window and pressure gates, and only then does its trade-level concentration, execution and capacity audit pass?

frozen_design.portfolio: monthly 60-day inverse-vol risk parity, 10% C cap, 15% joint equity volatility target, 60-day overlay at 15%, one-third equity-weight cap, gold 200-day trend defensive bucket

decision_rules: Rebuild every A/B/B20/C curve under the current engine; do not splice any old 2x curve into the current portfolio.
Reconciliation must pass before concentration, execution and capacity are used for a candidate decision.
If reconciliation fails, the trade audit is still reported diagnostically but the candidate is not advanced.
Report old-versus-current deltas explicitly and label R374-R379 as pre-fix engine vintage if exact reconstruction does not hold.
No parameter changes, no best-cell selection, no leverage, no paper target, no orders and no production enablement.
known_limits: The current engine rebuild is a new engine vintage, not an independent market sample.
C and A capacity notionals are reconstructed from equal-position nominal size because their abbreviated caches lack full entry_value records.
Daily amount is a liquidity proxy; intraday depth and impact curves are unavailable.
Industry labels remain a current snapshot.
The sealed window remains one approximately 17-month period.
